published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned Scaffold-Effects repository identifies the exercised system as Goose and publishes its config, system prompt, raw Harbor trial tree, normalized trial telemetry, and frozen aggregate snapshots. The committed config uses `version: stable` rather than an immutable Goose package/source revision, and W1 found no current canonical Goose linkage in the capability corpus; no canonical historical linkage is inferred.

result.model_config: source model label qwen/qwen3.6-plus; Harbor provider class `openai` over an OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible endpoint; exact service-side checkpoint/revision not published

provenance.public_result_surface: frozen aggregate.json plus 150-row trials.jsonl and raw Harbor result tree
provenance.execution_environment: Harbor orchestration in Daytona sandboxes; same 50-task selected Terminal-Bench Pro slice; identical task Docker image per task; source-declared 40-turn budget

unknown_dimensions: immutable Goose package/source revision; committed config says version stable
exact OpenRouter/backend model checkpoint serving qwen/qwen3.6-plus
provider-adapter route differs from OpenCode's native OpenRouter provider path
harness-native prompt, tool surface and retry/control policy differ by study design
token accounting is Goose-specific reconstructed lump-sum telemetry and is not normalized by W1
observations.notes: Primary collector defines `solved` from positive reward. Failure category is exception-first, so post-hoc `failure_categories.SOLVED` can differ from the solved count; W1 preserves both source fields without reconciling them.
